{{Quote|The Jedi failed to prevent the capture of one of their cruisers, the ''Renown'', and upon interception of encrypted transmissions regarding this plot, dispatched their own mission &ndash; separate from, and unsanctioned by, Republic Intelligence &ndash; to recover the decryption module.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], in a [[Reformation of Jedi military command|memorandum]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="FB">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=494382640601035|name=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''|date=2013-01-15|archivefile=File:Memo.jpg}}</ref>}}
The '''''Renown''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was stolen from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and stationed above [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], where it was loaded with huge amounts of [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] fuel contained in canisters.

==History==
[[File:Carida_Incident.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Renown'' destroyed in a massive rhydonium-fueled explosion]]
Its purpose was to destroy the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'' station]], where the whole [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and Republic command held a [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|strategy conference]]. However, the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], with the aid of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], managed to get on the ship, and being warned of the threat, managed to overpower the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and the [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droids]] (where [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ]] sacrificed himself to save the others), and with the help of the heroic deed of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], barely managed to [[Carida Incident|blow up the ship]] before it reached the star base, causing only minor damage. R2 was later rebuilt. The near-aversion of the disaster regarding the ''Renown'' was what ultimately led to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to [[Reformation of Jedi military command|request]] to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that the Jedi military command undergo a restructuring.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Renown'' had first appeared in the episode ''[[Missing in Action]]'' as part of the D-Squad arc's conclusion. However, it was never identified in either the episode itself or [[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|''Point of No Return'']]. It was later identified three days after the airing of the latter episode, on the official ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Facebook page, in an image detailing a document where Tarkin requested that the Jedi military command end up restructured to Palpatine. According to a post on the Facebook page, the destruction of the ''Renown'' was the biggest explosion the animators had created at that time in the animated series.
